payload.props_realized: Every value prop is realized by a story: 'isolated by default' + 'live server drives it' -> STORY 1 (killer, = UC-1); 'trim its own machine' -> STORY 2 (UC-2); 'ship honestly' -> STORY 3 (UC-3).
payload.stories_generalized: Every story sits inside a use case: STORY 1 -> UC-1, STORY 2 -> UC-2, STORY 3 -> UC-3; each carries a main path plus extensions.
payload.roles_covered: No role left out: owner, driving agent, adjudicator, maintainer, and the enabled-but-unstaffed parallel-agent role. Tensions named: default-isolation vs convenience (resolved for isolation); ship-fast vs proven-live (resolved for proven).
payload.excluded_stated: The binding excluded-use list exists (draw_context): no auto-skip decision, no two-at-once demo, no phone/i8 bless touch, no general strike-list, no push, no i9 board work.
payload.examples_formulated: The scenario paths ARE the formulated examples: UC-1 main + ext 5a (the routing-defect example that becomes the live test), UC-2 main + ext 3a (dangling-edge refusal), UC-3 main (suspect-on-second-ship). These seed the M8 live/acceptance tests.
